Title: The Seafood That's Secretly Triggering Your Gout Attacks

Description:
Shrimp cocktail, sardines, and anchovies are staples on American menus - and all three are loaded with purines that turn into uric acid crystals in your joints. Gout already affects about 9.2 million American adults, and one large U.S. study found each extra weekly seafood serving raises gout risk by 7%.

Watch to find out why these three seafood favorites raise uric acid, and what to swap in instead so you don't have to give up seafood for good.
